modules.name: RackMCP-Bridge
modules.description: Control and status module for the Rack MCP local bridge: connection status, writer lease, pairing reset, and persistence warnings.

modules.name: RackMCP-Probe
modules.description: Signal-analysis probe for Rack MCP telemetry: per-channel min/max, peak, RMS, DC, clip and edge counts over explicit probe cables.

modules.name: RackMCP-Tutorial
modules.description: Guided setup for Rack MCP, checked against the live rack: each step verifies real state (bridge listening, host paired, writer lease held, transaction committed) rather than being ticked off by hand.
